name: Leshy, Fungus
body:
FUNGUS LESHY
CR 5

Mismatched eyes dot this plant creature’s thick mushroom cap, while below works an overlarge maw set with pale fungal teeth.

XP 1,600
CG Small plant (leshy)
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +11

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 14, flat-footed 15 (+3 Dex, +4 natural, +1 size)
hp 59 (7d8+28)
Fort +8, Ref +6, Will +3
Immune electricity, plant traits, sonic

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee 2 slams +9 (1d4+1)
Ranged puffball +9 (1d8 plus spores)
Special Attacks sneak attack +4d6, verdant channel 3/day (4d6)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th; concentration +6)

At-Will—tree shape (small mushroom only)
Constant—pass without trace, speak with plants

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 17, Con 16, Int 11, Wis 13, Cha 8
Base Atk +5; CMB +5; CMD 19
Feats Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Toughness, Weapon Finesse
Skills Perception +11, Stealth +17 (+21 Stealth in forest), Survival +1 (+5 Survival in forest); Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth and Survival in forests
Languages Common, Druidic, Sylvan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Puffball (Ex)

A fungus leshy can spit a puffball as a standard action. If it hits, this attack deals 1d8 point of damage (not modified by Strength) and affects the target struck (but not adjacent targets) with its spores. The puffball has a range increment of 20 feet.

Spores (Ex)

Anytime a fungus leshy takes damage, a cloud of spores bursts from its body, forcing all adjacent creatures to make a DC 16 Fortitude save. Those who fail have their vision reduced to 5 feet for 1 minute (plant creatures are immune to this effect). Creatures with reduced vision are flat-footed to attacks. Spending a full-round action to wash one’s eyes with water ends this effect. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Verdant Channel (Ex)

A fungus leshy can channel verdant energy to a range of 30 feet. This acts as channel positive energy, but it can only heal plant creatures and deals no damage to undead.
